name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the generated continuation addresses the given prompt or instruction.
scale: 0 to 5, where 0 is completely irrelevant and 5 is highly relevant.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical consistency and flow within the generated continuation.
scale: 0 to 5, where 0 is completely incoherent and 5 is perfectly coherent.

name: Fluency
description: Evaluates the grammatical correctness and naturalness of the language used in the continuation.
scale: 0 to 5, where 0 is highly unnatural or ungrammatical and 5 is perfectly fluent.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and innovativeness of the response in comparison to typical or expected answers.
scale: 0 to 5, where 0 is not creative at all and 5 is highly creative.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the ability of the continuation to capture and maintain the reader's interest.
scale: 0 to 5, where 0 is not engaging at all and 5 is highly engaging.

name: BLEU Score
description: Evaluates the similarity of the generated continuation to a set of reference continuations using n-gram overlap.
scale: 0 to 1, where 0 is no overlap and 1 is perfect overlap.

name: ROUGE Score
description: Measures the recall of the generated continuation in terms of overlap with reference continuations, focusing on n-grams and longest common subsequences.
scale: 0 to 1, where 0 is no recall and 1 is perfect recall.

name: Human Satisfaction
description: Gauges the overall satisfaction of human evaluators with the response, considering all aspects of quality.
scale: 0 to 5, where 0 is not satisfied at all and 5 is extremely satisfied.
